fact: The digital transition minister launched the public administration interoperability platform, built on Cybernetica's UXP, in Abidjan on 25 September 2025; the pilot phase covers twelve public bodies.
The Public Administration Interoperability Platform, based on Cybernetica's UXP, was officially launched on 25 September 2025, with twelve pilot institutions to integrate in the first phase.
The head of SNDI said at the 3 September 2026 workshop that the national interoperability platform is a reality and already improves data exchange between several administrations.

The Minister of Digital Transition launched a public-administration interoperability platform in Abidjan on 25 September 2025 for data exchange between state information systems, built on Cybernetica's UXP and commissioned from SNDI, with a 20-month implementation alongside Digital Afrique Telecom; the document does not say it is carrying data between named bodies.
